Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
SCENE/GOAL: L4D-style campaign, hotel rooftop finale. After long search for the finale trigger, descended ROOF ACCESS stairwell into floor 8 (suite 802 hallway, lobby with ELEVATOR doors, EXIT-sign corridor, burning meat-prep/storage rooms). Now HANGING off a window ledge after falling out of a burning room during a fire-crossing attempt. Bots: Coach, Rochelle, Ellis. Goal remains: find/activate finale trigger or extraction. Health ~+48 at fall, HUD ~+70-88 much of the descent.

CONTROLS (observed): WASD move; Shift sprint; E interact (works rarely: opened grey stairwell door and storeroom metal door; did nothing on elevator doors/plates, METER boxes, alarm box under ROOF ACCESS sign, fence, ledges); J fire, used by bots' heal prompt ('HOLD [J] to heal yourself'); K shove; left-click attack (axe); 1 = axe/primary, 4 medkit, 5 pills (needs two clicks: select then consume; gave temp HP). Space jump. Control_L crouch toggle — no visible effect. Scroll — no effect. Arrow keys pitch/yaw slowly and often ignored. KEY FINDING: plain pointer moves are usually ignored, but DRAG actions DO drive the camera, inverted (drag up = look down, drag down = look up); horizontal drags yaw. Varying drag magnitude matters — identical repeats stop registering; large varied drags (~0.6-0.9 screen span) moved pitch most. Control actions combining movement + big dy also change pitch. Camera locks for many turns when wedged against sloped surfaces/walls; broken by long (1.0s) S presses, long W+turn steps, or W+space. After unstick, W+space often raises view to eye level.

HEALING (observed): medkit heal with held J accumulated across consecutive holds and COMPLETED once, restoring to +88 (bar stalls 80-95% but finishes with one more hold). Bots auto-heal when standing still; health has also recovered passively (70->88, 84->80 etc.). Acid/standing hazards drained HP slowly; fire contact drained 70->48 quickly.

LEDGE HANGS (observed): 'A teammate must pull you up' prompt with +300 decaying hang budget (decays ~3 per 5s, occasionally frozen). Three earlier exterior-ledge falls resolved only after dozens of patient turns once a bot pathed to the sill; then 'BEING HELPED UP' slow bar. Current hang: bots appear as blue silhouettes through walls, cluster at a burning window and occasionally path along the exterior to a second unburned window sill directly above my hands, but have NOT triggered the pull-up across ~80+ turns. Tried: waits (many), E/J/K/F/R holds, Space, W+A climb, crouch, pointer warps, drags (aligning crosshair onto bots), left-clicks (only make the survivor swing). Shimmying A/D along the sill works in small increments and shifts which window is overhead; bots track roughly with it. Hang budget down to ~114. Do not assume a nearby silhouette means the bot can reach the sill (ghost-through-wall rendering).

NAVIGATION (observed): Rooftop has white structures, ROOF ACCESS lit plaque doorway, chain-link perimeter, helipad white cross pad on an ADJACENT LOWER roof (fence blocks; leaning fence ladder near containers never tested at point-blank), radio mast beyond fence (not interactable). Stairwell inside white structure descends over many flights (blue railings, pipes) to floor 8: checkered carpets, suites 802, lobby with ELEVATOR-labelled door (inert), EXIT-sign corridor, STAIRS sign pointing left at a burning doorway, back kitchen with corpse mound/levers, storage room with shelving, grey door, and burn-scarred halls. Fire blocks hall ends; sprinting through hurt but was survivable.

FAILED/GUESSES: E-tap interactions at nearly all rooftop/floor-8 props failed (METER boxes, alarm station, elevator door/plates, tables, blue-glowing items, boxes, fence). The blue glow near the ROOF ACCESS doorway was probably Ellis's flashlight/weapon, not a pickup. Elevator likely inert scenery. Friendly-fire warning appeared when a teammate crossed the crosshair. Unresolved hypotheses (guesses): finale trigger may be a small black device on the rooftop parapet near the helipad overlook (never E-tested at point-blank); helipad cross pad may be the extraction point requiring descent; a holdout may already be active (Tank, Charger, Jockey, Boomer waves seen) so survival and staying with the team may suffice; the true 'use' key may be J but J only heals with medkit equipped. No evidence the hang can self-resolve except continued patience or a bot reaching the exact sill tile. Prompt text 'HOLD [F]'/'<not bound>' appears despite different effective bindings.
